versos.e: .Is derived from Their wealth Job 21:13; Ps 52:7 Their power Job 21:7; Ps 37:35 Their worldly prosperity Ps 17:14; 37:3,4,7 Gluttony Isa 22:13; Hab 1:16 Drunkenness Isa 5:11; 56:12 Vain pleasure Job 21:12; Isa 5:12 Successful oppression Hab 1:15
.Often interrupted by judgments Nu 11:33; Job 15:21; Ps 73:18-20; Jer 25:10,11

.Saints often permitted to see the end of Ps 73:17-20
